name: 商务通勤大容量防水双肩包款
description: 大容量分区收纳、防泼水面料、透气背负，通勤旅行一包搞定

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating full-width flat bands of pure white #FFFFFF and light grey #F0F0F0; hero opens on a split #FFFFFF/#F0F0F0 wall with optional muted green #7C9A6D botanical shadow decor and a matte white round podium
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows only, neutral color temperature; lower-key directional light reserved for the pain-point panel only
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white round podium and seamless flat band backgrounds; no textured or reflective surfaces
styleLock.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif (CJK-safe) headlines with a thin divider underline; short labels only, no dense body text
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line rounded-square outline icons with uniform #2D2D2D stroke, plus black #2D2D2D circular numbered badges for callouts
styleLock.presentationRules: product rendered near-black on light bands, centered and upright, stable front 3/4 hero angle reused across variant and closing shots; callouts always via numbered badges or short labels
noDrift: no brand logos, watermarks or QR codes
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent minimal monochrome ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF and light grey #F0F0F0 band backgrounds, near-black text #1A1A1A, charcoal accent #2D2D2D, optional muted green #7C9A6D botanical shadow decor on the hero only; neutral temperature; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines with a thin divider line; consistent thin-line rounded-square outline icons and black circular numbered badges; bright even high-key studio lighting with soft contact shadows; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale, centered and upright placement; clean margins around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 三秒立住「通勤、旅行、上学多场合+大容量防水」的核心卖点，赢得停留与点击。
shots.camera: eye-level straight-on hero: product standing upright on a round white podium, front view and rear 3/4 view as a pair
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadow under the podium
shots.background: split flat wall, left half #FFFFFF and right half #F0F0F0, optional muted green #7C9A6D botanical shadow decor at two corners
shots.props: matte white round podium, one matte grey #D9D9D9 sphere at lower left
shots.whitespace: open split-wall composition with breathing room around the podium and the copy
shots.textZone: top 40% copy zone: thin-bordered kicker box, oversized headline, charcoal pill, and three charcoal circle labels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce detail-page opening hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. {product} standing upright on a matte white round podium, front view and rear 3/4 view as a pair, photographed at eye level. Bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key, soft contact shadow. Split flat wall background, left half #FFFFFF and right half #F0F0F0, with subtle muted green #7C9A6D botanical shadow decor in the top-left and bottom-right corners and one matte grey #D9D9D9 sphere at lower left. Top 40% is the copy zone: a thin-bordered kicker box reading 「{callout_1}」, an oversized bold headline in #1A1A1A reading 「{selling_point_1}」, a charcoal #2D2D2D pill reading 「{callout_2}」, and three charcoal #2D2D2D circles labelled 「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」. Product occupies 50-60% of frame in an open split-wall composition with breathing room around the podium and the copy. 2K commercial detail-page quality. Negative: no brand logos, no fake logo, no watermark, no QR code, no garbled text, no hands, no cut-off product, no gradient background, no extra props.

shots.intent: 一屏扫清「能否定型、能否装电脑、背板闷不闷、能否挂行李箱」的功能疑问。
shots.camera: flat straight-on infographic row, no camera perspective
shots.lighting: flat even lighting (pure graphic layout, no photographic shadows)
shots.whitespace: even margins framing the icon row, about 15% panel margins on each side
shots.textZone: four evenly spaced icon-and-label groups across the middle band
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic feature strip for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A flat straight-on row of four evenly spaced thin-line rounded-square outline icons with uniform #2D2D2D stroke on a full-width light grey #F0F0F0 band, each icon followed by a short label in #1A1A1A reading 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」. Clean minimal layout, the icon row spans the middle band with even margins framing it, about 15% panel margins on each side. 2K. Negative: no product rendering, no brand logos, no watermark, no garbled text, no dense body text, no gradient background, no 3D effects, no drop shadows.

shots.lighting: natural soft daylight around 5500K, consistent light direction and plausible shadows across tiles
shots.background: real environments (urban sidewalk, transit hall, office corner), tiles framed on #FFFFFF
shots.props: max one small prop per tile (coffee cup, distant suitcase, office chair), never covering the product
shots.whitespace: airy triptych with lifestyle space breathing inside each tile
shots.textZone: top strip: bold headline with thin divider and one short subtitle line

Bottom-right tile: {product} resting against an office desk chair. Natural soft daylight around 5500K, consistent light direction, believable contact shadows. Negative: no faces, no brand logos, no garbled signage text, no watermark, no hands covering the product, no cluttered scene, no warped body proportions, no duplicated background objects.

provenance.notes: 9 张详情页切片（800×1200、60px 重叠）拼合分析；源长图多数图片位为灰色懒加载空块，实拍仅存首屏、规格与商品展示三处，中段功能/场景镜按版式结构与可见文案推断重建；已剥离：包身品牌小标、角落二维码及会员促销贴、规格表品牌/编号字段、全部原文文案改为 {callout}/{selling_point} 文案槽并以 {product} 占位；源文件夹名「便携式双肩包」与图中主体（黑色方形商务通勤双肩包）一致，无冲突。
